title: CampHealSURVIVE
description: A survival mechanic that turns campfires into healing sources inspired by Fortnite-style campfires.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/71d231635e926de877ba480cc55075d9d00a2f46.jpeg)

**CampHealSURVIVE** adds a new survival mechanic where campfires can restore health to nearby players.

Inspired by healing campfires from Fortnite, players can fuel campfires to activate a temporary healing zone.

The mechanic is designed to stay balanced while adding a useful survival feature during exploration and multiplayer fights.

## Healing Radius 📏

When a campfire is active, players standing within 2–3 blocks receive slow health regeneration.

The closer the player is to the fire, the more consistent the regeneration becomes.

## Fuel System 💡

Campfires require fuel to stay active.

Players can interact with the campfire and add fuel items:

- Sticks
- Any wooden block
- Charcoal
- Coal

Each fuel item increases the fire’s power level.

## Fire Power System 🔥

Campfires have 4 power stages, similar to Fortnite.

Each stage increases the healing strength.

- Stage 1 – Weak fire
- Stage 2 – Stable fire
- Stage 3 – Strong fire
- Stage 4 – Maximum power

After reaching maximum power, the fire slowly loses strength until it extinguishes.

## Temporary Campfire

A normal campfire lasts 20 seconds after activation.

Players must keep adding wood or sticks to maintain the fire.

If no fuel is added, the fire slowly weakens and eventually goes out.

## Permanent Campfire Mode

Players can convert a campfire into a permanent decorative fire.

To activate permanent mode:

Add 64 coal or charcoal

Permanent campfires:

- never extinguish
- provide very slow regeneration
- mainly act as decorative healing points

Gameplay Balance

To prevent the mechanic from being overpowered:

- Healing is slow
- The effect only works within 3 blocks
- Players must remain close to the fire
- Permanent fires heal much slower

This keeps the mechanic useful without replacing food or potions.

## Compatibility 🎮

The mod works in:

- Singleplayer
- Multiplayer (if installed on all players)
- Servers where the mod is installed
